title: 30 MIN FULL BODY HIIT with weights (NO REPEATS, NO JUMPING)
notes: Exercise list reconstructed from the video's spoken transcript. 'match' = exact | close | combo (two catalog exercises per interval) | loose | none, relative to the WorkoutX catalog entry.

intervals.name: Step Jacks
intervals.note: Video does the low-impact step-out version of a jumping jack — step out, no jump.

intervals.name: Bum Kicks (butt kicks, side to side)
intervals.note: No butt-kick exercise in catalog; reuse Step Jacks GIF or record a custom one. Side-to-side heel-to-glute steps with optional arm swings.

intervals.name: Power Half Lunge + Knee Drive (right)
intervals.note: Static half-lunge stance, then explosive knee drive up on the right leg. Catalog's Walking High Knees Lunge shows the lunge + knee-up pattern.

intervals.name: Power Half Lunge + Knee Drive (left)
intervals.note: Same as previous, left leg.

intervals.name: Standing Star Crunch
intervals.note: Big star stance, reach for opposite toe/knee side to side.

intervals.name: Bodyweight Squat
intervals.note: Plain bodyweight squat; catalog GIF adds an overhead reach — just skip the reach.

intervals.name: Calf Raise + Cross Toe Touch
intervals.note: Rise on tiptoes with arms overhead, then hinge down reaching for the opposite toe, arm back. Combines calf raise (this GIF) with a cross toe touch.

intervals.name: High Plank Toe Taps
intervals.note: In high plank, tap one toe in toward hands at a time, slow and controlled — like a slow mountain climber.

intervals.name: Glute Bridges
intervals.note: Focus on form: press low back down, squeeze at top.

intervals.name: Squat to Overhead Press (2 dumbbells)
intervals.note: Thruster pattern; catalog GIF uses kettlebells — do it with two dumbbells, palms facing, explosive at the top.

intervals.name: Deadlift + Upright Row (2 dumbbells)
intervals.note: Alternate one dumbbell deadlift (id 0300) with one upright row (id 0437). Flat back, lead with elbows on the row.

intervals.name: Side Lunge to Curtsy Squat (right)
intervals.note: Side lunge right, back through center into curtsy squat; one dumbbell held at chest, optional.

intervals.name: Side Lunge to Curtsy Squat (left)
intervals.note: Same as previous, left side.

intervals.name: Dumbbell Swing
intervals.note: Kettlebell-swing pattern holding one dumbbell with both hands. Hip hinge, glutes and core drive it.

intervals.name: Commandos + Step Out
intervals.note: Plank up-downs (hands to elbows) alternated with plank foot step-outs. No commando GIF available on free plan (5204 exists but watermarked GIF unavailable); this GIF is a related plank-transition move.

intervals.name: Weighted Russian Twist
intervals.note: Skip the weight until the bodyweight twist is mastered.

intervals.name: Weighted Sit-up
intervals.note: Full sit-up holding a dumbbell at chest or arms extended overhead.

intervals.name: Plank Pull-Throughs
intervals.note: High plank, drag the dumbbell under the body to the opposite side, no hip sway. Closest catalog match is the renegade row (same anti-rotation plank + dumbbell).

intervals.name: Side Plank Crunch (side 1)
intervals.note: Forearm + knee side plank, lift into side crunch. Stack shoulder over elbow.

intervals.name: Side Plank Crunch (side 2)
intervals.note: Same as previous, other side.

intervals.name: Plank Walkout + Overhead Press
intervals.note: Inchworm walkout (id 1471), walk back, pick up dumbbell, overhead press (id 0426).

intervals.name: Squat + Hammer Curl (2 dumbbells)
intervals.note: Dumbbell squat (id 0413) into hammer curl at the top (id 0313).

intervals.name: Single-Leg RDL (side 1)
intervals.note: Leg lifted or toe as kickstand; flat back, eyes on a fixed spot.

intervals.name: Single-Leg RDL (side 2)
intervals.note: Same as previous, other side.

intervals.name: Alternating Reverse Lunges (2 dumbbells)
intervals.note: Alternate legs each rep.

intervals.name: Standing Crunch with Dumbbell (march)
intervals.note: Marching knee-up with a crunch action, dumbbell held at chest. Catalog GIF shows the standing crunch pattern with a band instead.

intervals.name: Dumbbell Snatch (side 1)
intervals.note: Explosive; dumbbell finishes overhead, arm nearly extended.

intervals.name: Dumbbell Snatch (side 2)
intervals.note: Same as previous, other arm.

intervals.name: Push-ups (final minute)
intervals.note: On toes, half push-ups, or hold a plank — last 40s, empty the tank.
